current_runtime.scope: Every joint starts at its limit midpoint; five spread-out cube regions, active self-collision, original SO101 placement, appearance and friction.
current_runtime.ik_backend: Arm-owned SciPy bounded nonlinear least_squares, Newton FK/analytic Jacobian, measured pose feedback with integral compensation

source.reason: Same measured tabletop XY placement and base orientation as SO101. SP7 base_link starts at its support surface; its Z correction seats that CAD origin on the tabletop.

limitations: Real hardware transmission, calibration and driver remain unconfigured.
Only the explicitly recorded tabletop sampling region is verified by these datasets; full URDF workspace coverage is not established.
current_runtime.self_collision_filter_policy: Fixed and mechanically adjacent assemblies plus interlocking slide-guide interfaces; jaw/jaw and distal gripper/base remain active

gripper_collision_refinement.reason: Source CAD slide-guide faces overlap by roughly0.13mm and jam when sibling contacts are enabled
gripper_collision_refinement.representation: Conservative convex envelopes of clipped original URDF mesh vertices; visuals and inertias retained

wrist_collision_geometry.method: Baked concave bracket convex decomposition; conservative volume-bounded merging

initial_pose.policy: Identical fixed pose for every episode: every joint at the midpoint of its limits
